test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 29 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following statements are correct in the context of the Indian Constitution?

1. There are three major organs of the government, namely Legislature, Executive and Judiciary.

2. A separation of functions rather than powers is followed.

3. All organs of the government are independent.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1 and 2 only.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Indian government is divided into three organs:
 
 
• The Legislature **(Parliament) **makes laws.
 
• The Executive **(President, Prime Minister, and Cabinet)** implements laws.
 
• The Judiciary interprets laws and **ensures justice**. Hence **statement 1 is correct.**
 
 
 
• India follows the separation of functions between the organs rather than a strict separation of powers. While each organ has specific roles, they often interact
